question: The first population census in India was conducted in _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1872.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** first population census** in India was conducted in **1872.**
 
• The census was conducted during the** British rule in India.**
 
• The census was conducted by **Lord Mayo**, who was the **Governor-General of India** at that time.
 
• The census covered only **British-administered territories **and did not include princely states.
 
• The census was conducted to gather information about the population and to understand the** social and economic conditions **of the people.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Population Census**:

 
 
• A population census is a process of collecting, compiling, and publishing **demographic, social, and economic data** about the people living in a** specific geographic area.**
 
 
 
• The census helps in understanding the **size, distribution, and characteristics of the population.**
 
• The census data is used by **governments, policymakers, researchers, and businesses** for planning, decision-making, and resource allocation.
 
• The population census is conducted periodically in most countries, and the data collected is used for a variety of purposes, including **electoral representation, public health, education, and infrastructure planning.**
